liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Brokedown Palace** (5 reviews): Recording cuts off at the line about the river singing sweet, just as Jerry sings it; Tender, slow tempo held by drummers; piano and organ-like fills; Garcia's vocal phrasing inventive and solo perfect [9][12][15][16][20]
- **Dancin' in the Streets** (3 reviews): Dancin' is lively and connects into Brown Eyed Women, where the jam really starts working; Reviewer calls the Dancin' very hot [10][11][13]
- **Playin' in the Band** (2 reviews): Playin' is so soupy that the songs between intro and reprise get lost in it; Around the four minute mark of Playin', everything starts floating [10][20]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One is described as amazing [13]
- **Comes A Time** (1 review): Comes a Time stood out most; reviewer suggests turning the levels up [19]

## Setlist highlights

- **Beer Barrel Polka Tuning**: back after 111 archived shows (1040 days); rare: 10 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd77-05-01.aud.goodbear.11941.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 209 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording is clear, not muddy like the Sony source [17]
- **gd1977-05-01.151749.1st.set.shure.sm57.sublette.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 12 songs; 81 min [4]
- **gd1977-05-01set-2.mtx.sirmick.87285.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 9 songs; 75 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]
- **gd77-05-01.set2-sbd.unknown.4763.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 9 songs; 71 min; rated 4.71/5 by 24 [7]. Said about its sound: Soundboard of the second set is crystal clear; Soundboard has nice stereo separation of the instruments; Soundboard has a great mix and is very clear [9][11][15][20]

## Around the show

- The crowd is energetic and jumping [17]
- Lazy Lightning flows into Supplication; Brokedown Palace was the encore [1]
- Comes a Time is as magnificent as any May 1977 version [13]
- Reviewer suggests The Music Never Stopped from May 5th for filling an 80 minute CD [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-05-01.aud.goodbear.11941.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Taped by Barry Glassberg with Sony ECM 99P microphones from the first-row center loge; Chain: cassette master to reel, then PCM R500, DAT, CD-R, EAC and SHN [1]
- **gd1977-05-01.151749.1st.set.shure.sm57.sublette.mattes.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Kathy Sublette's Master Audience Cassettes; Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 [4]
- **gd1977-05-01set-2.mtx.sirmick.87285.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by edited and matrixed by SirMick; source: See info file [6]. Also: Second set chain: soundboard to master reel, DAT, CD, then FLAC; transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller [6]
- **gd77-05-01.set2-sbd.unknown.4763.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [7]
